title: A wider search in the engine, chosen honestly: Optuna on the stage's choice and the screen's next family, the winner confirmed once on a selection fold (34.7a with 34.6)
request: The owner asked to finish Phase 10 without stopping. The plan (docs/guides/PHASE10_ABILITIES_PLAN.md, 34.7) asks for a per-family search with a budget, CatBoost reconsidered, stacking of the top families, all chosen through 34.6's selection fold, the exported code reproducing it, and on the bake-off datasets a holdout score that rises with the measured optimism inside its interval at bounded minutes. The search was built first (34.7a); stacking and CatBoost (34.7b) wait for the owner.
spec: dclab_rnd/studio/search.py (settings, space, cut, run); the models stage runs it after its screen and review when the project's settings ask; the final stage fits the searched settings as they are; dclab_rnd/search_measure.py (campaign search_v2).
plan: read 34.6's selection library and the engine's models and final stages
write the search behind an opt-in setting, the selection fold set aside before it, the winner confirmed once
make the final stage fit the searched settings without re-tuning
measure both arms fresh on pinned code over nine bake-off datasets with gates fixed before the run

decisions.decision: The search is off unless a project's settings ask for it
decisions.why: a selection fold takes training rows from every project, and the search costs minutes; it is offered, not imposed, until a measurement says it helps

decisions.decision: Search the stage's own choice first, with the review's kept change as the base of every trial
decisions.why: the review's change was measured on the same folds; dropping it would make the search start behind the stage it is meant to improve

decisions.decision: Compare the winner with the stage's choice without a search on the same selection fold
decisions.why: the selection score alone says how good the winner is, not whether the search added anything; the paired gain with its interval says that

decisions.decision: Skip the search with the reason when no fair cut exists, never search on an unfair one
decisions.why: a selection fold missing a class or sharing entities with the search rows would confirm the winner on rows it partly saw or cannot score

decisions.decision: Measure both arms fresh in a new campaign (search_v2) and abort search_v1
decisions.why: search_v1 compared the search with the bake-off's predictions from an older engine and had gates that could not tell a gain; a changed protocol is a new campaign, never an edit

decisions.decision: Do not build stacking and CatBoost (34.7b) now; revisit on the M1 Max with bigger tables
decisions.why: the owner's call after search_v2: a stack needs the same selection fold and pays the same price, and neither the bake-off nor the search found room above the engine's defaults on these tables

change: dclab_rnd/studio/search.py (new); dclab_rnd/studio/engine.py (Prepared.search and search_cut, the fold set aside in prepare, the models stage's search block, the models decision's searched flag, the final stage's searched branch); dclab_rnd/studio/lineage.py (search among the run settings); dclab_rnd/ledger/capture.py (model.family's rule when the search chose); dclab_rnd/search_measure.py (new); tests/test_search_engine.py, tests/test_search_measure.py. requirements/product.txt (Optuna).

findings.defect: the final stage tuned the searched settings again
findings.scenario: a searched project's final stage tried its own candidates on top of the search's choice
findings.cause: the final stage did not know the settings came from the search
findings.fix: stage_final(searched=True) tries no candidates and says so in its decision and claim; a person's adopted change on top resets it
findings.impact: a model the selection fold never saw read the holdout

findings.defect: entities shared across the selection fold on a time split with entities
findings.scenario: a customer in the search rows also scored the selection fold
findings.cause: the cut took the latest rows by time only
findings.fix: the selection fold and the search folds drop the rows of any entity the other side holds

findings.defect: a class could be missing from one side
findings.scenario: a rare class absent from the latest rows or from a group cut
findings.cause: no class check on the cut
findings.fix: group and stratified cuts retry up to 20 seeds; a time cut cannot; otherwise the search is skipped with the reason
findings.impact: a crash or a mis-scored metric

findings.defect: the review's kept change was lost in the search
findings.scenario: the review kept class weights; the search's trials started from defaults
findings.cause: the search knew only the screen
findings.fix: the review's change is the base of every trial of its family; class weight is never drawn on top of it
findings.impact: the search started behind the stage

findings.defect: the ledger said the screen's rule chose a family the search chose
findings.impact: a wrong label for the decision models

findings.defect: the search score was called a mean and nothing said whether the search helped
findings.scenario: the record compared the winner with nothing
findings.fix: the score is called pooled out-of-fold; the stage's choice without a search is fitted and scored on the same selection fold with a paired interval of the gain
findings.impact: a search claimed useful without evidence

findings.defect: claim limits, the stage's mean, a missing library and the run's lineage
findings.scenario: a searched project's record and replay
findings.cause: the search was added beside the stage without updating them
findings.fix: the claim says where the gain was read; selected_metric_mean is the winner's own score; Optuna missing skips with the reason; search counts among a run's settings

findings.scenario: search_v1 read the arm without a search from the bake-off's older engine, ran unpinned code and had gates a gain could not pass
findings.cause: the campaign was written before the search was reviewed
findings.fix: search_v2: both arms fresh, code pinned by hash with a resume on changed code refused, captured predictions checked against each record, four gates, a time, a group-with-text and a multiclass dataset added; search_v1 marked aborted
findings.impact: a result that would not mean what it said
alternatives: keep search_v1 and edit its gates (refused: a changed protocol is a new campaign)

findings.defect: a group split with one large group crashed the models stage
findings.scenario: entity sizes 25, 900, 25, 25, 25: the greedy cut left one group to search and the folds asked for one split
findings.cause: a cut was accepted whatever it left on each side
findings.fix: a group cut is drawn again when the search rows hold fewer than two groups or more than half the rows are set aside, or the split raised; the folds of one group are none, so the search skips with its reason
findings.impact: a project failed on every rerun

findings.defect: the selection fold was not clean
findings.scenario: the features stage, the screen and the review scored on folds over every training row, the later selection rows included, and chose the recipe, the families searched and the comparator
findings.cause: the fold was set aside only when the search started
findings.fix: prepare sets the selection fold aside before any stage scores and cuts the project's folds again over the search rows only
findings.test: tests/test_search_engine.py (no fold holds a selection row)
findings.impact: an understated optimism and a gain pushed toward zero
alternatives: say it as a limit only (the smallest fix)

findings.defect: the product image had no Optuna
findings.scenario: every searched project in the container was skipped
findings.cause: Optuna was in the research requirements only
findings.impact: the setting did nothing in the product

findings.defect: the selection score's interval drew rows on entity splits
findings.fix: the chosen one's interval is drawn again over whole entities
alternatives: add groups to dclab_core.selection.choose (a contract change)

findings.defect: two rule names for one decision, and the search's numbers not in the ledger's state
findings.scenario: a person overrides a searched family
findings.cause: the approval capture named its own rule
findings.fix: the approval's rule answer is rule:search_select when the search chose; the numbers stay in the stage record (they are known only after the choice, so they are no state a student reads before deciding)
findings.open: the attempts and the optimism as a measured label, if the decision models need them

findings.defect: the record kept 20 of the attempts
findings.cause: only the top 20 by score were kept
findings.fix: every attempt in order with its index; the top 20 kept beside it
findings.impact: attempts lost from the training records

findings.defect: the final stage's rule text spoke of candidates it did not try
findings.cause: the rule text had no searched branch
findings.impact: a record that said the wrong rule

findings.defect: the leakage stage's random folds still read the selection fold
findings.scenario: a time-split project with a search: the random-versus-time comparison drew its folds over every training row
findings.cause: those folds were built over the training rows, not over the rows the time folds use
findings.fix: the random folds are drawn over the rows the project's folds cover (the same rows without a search)
findings.impact: a gap and its ledger label read on different rows; no choice depended on it
findings.open: a route that turns the search on after the features stage must clear the stages from data

findings.defect: 34.4's operating-point records were refused and lost
findings.scenario: another session's real-table engine run: the ledger refused the state field 'of'
findings.cause: the field was never in dclab_core.ledger.STATE_FIELDS
findings.fix: the other session added it in dclab-core 0.112.0; the test here checks the record reaches the ledger
findings.test: tests/test_decisions_product.py (the chosen share reaches the ledger)

findings.defect: the search crashed the models stage on a rare outcome split by time
findings.scenario: credit_card_fraud in search_v2: the side without a search finished, the side with one failed at the models stage
findings.cause: setting the selection fold aside shrank the earliest fold of the search rows to rows without a single fraud case, so no model could be fitted there
findings.fix: set_aside skips the search, with the reason, when any fold of the search rows would miss a class on either side; the project's folds stay as they were
findings.test: tests/test_search_engine.py (a rare outcome early in time)
findings.impact: a project that works without the search setting failed with it
alternatives: drop the earliest fold (changes the project's protocol for one setting)

findings.defect: the clean selection fold costs every earlier choice a fifth of the training rows
findings.scenario: ecommerce_clothing_reviews: on the search rows the screen led with lightgbm where, on every row, logistic regression led; the search kept lightgbm and the holdout fell by 0.0078; adult the same way with a smaller loss
findings.cause: by design (R2): the features stage, the screen and the review choose on the search rows only, so their choices are noisier
findings.fix: none in this package: the search stays an opt-in, never recommended by this result
findings.impact: part of the measured loss comes from the set-aside, not from the search
alternatives: confirm the all-row choice instead (reads the selection rows before the end: the leak R2 removed)
a nested protocol (several times the minutes)
findings.open: whether a search is worth its fold on bigger tables (the M1 Max)

measurements.name: search_v2: the engine with a search against the same engine without one, both fresh on pinned code, on 9 bake-off datasets on an 8 GB MacBook Air
measurements.gate: pass when all four hold: at most 1 dataset with the holdout difference's whole 95% interval below 0; the mean holdout difference above 0; the selection fold's mean absolute gap to the holdout smaller than the search score's; every search within 1.5 times its 3-minute budget
measurements.result: 8 of 9 compared (the fraud table's search side crashed, R9); mean holdout difference -0.003891 (range -0.0256 to +0.0032); clearly better on none, clearly worse on 1 (ecommerce_clothing_reviews, -0.0078); mean absolute gaps to the holdout 0.0085 for the selection fold and 0.0096 for the search score; the selection fold's gain agreed in sign with the holdout on 2 datasets and disagreed on 3; the searches took 1.47 to 3.66 minutes
measurements.next: search_v3 (R9 fixed, a failed search side counted as clearly worse) on the same datasets: it cannot pass unless the eight numbers change, since the ninth is then skipped with a difference of 0
measurements.against_gate: The mean difference is below 0, so the gate that the search lifts the holdout fails; the other three hold.
limits: another session's jobs ran beside it, so the minutes are an upper bound
where the screen chose differently, the loss came from choosing on the rows left after the set-aside, not from the search (R10)

outcome: A project can ask for a wider search; the engine sets a selection fold aside before any stage scores, confirms the search's winner there, says what the search added over no search, and fits the result as it is. Measured on the bake-off's datasets (search_v2) it did not lift the holdout (mean -0.0039 on 8 datasets, better on none, worse on one): it stays an opt-in, never recommended by this result, and stacking waits for the owner's word.
lessons: Build the comparator into the record: a winner's score says how good it is, not whether the search that found it helped.
When a stage already improved a choice, a search must start from that improvement, or it measures itself against a weaker base.
A campaign written before its code is reviewed is often wrong in the same places; freeze it after the review.
Set a selection fold aside where the folds are made, not where it is first used: every earlier choice on those rows already reads it.
A clean selection fold has a price: every choice before it is made on fewer rows. Measure that price inside the search's result, never apart from it.
When the engine's defaults already match a tuned AutoML (the bake-off), a wider search has little room: measure the room before building more search.
risks: the selection fold takes a fifth of the training rows from a searched project
small tables give a selection fold too noisy to show a gain
